purpose: T101: replay the two top-ranked literature arms from the T100 round-3 survey on the daily 5-asset PIT cohort. Arm 1 = distance-from-high momentum (Prague WP: distance-from-1wk-high positive on large/liquid coins, t=+4.93; direction prior POSITIVE: near-high -> continuation). Arm 2 = liquidity-conditioned momentum/reversal flip (Zaremba IRFA 2021: illiquid coins reverse, liquid coins continue). Measurement only - no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

cohort.grid: per-asset daily decision_ns rows (1309-1312 per asset)
cohort.targets: forward log(mark) returns recomputed per asset: primary 5d (mark[i+5]/mark[i]), secondary 1d (mark[i+1]/mark[i]); PIT-safe (targets strictly after decision bar)

definitions.dfh20: mark[i] / max(mark[i-20:i]) - 1 (trailing 20d high over strictly prior bars); dfh10 variant uses max(mark[i-10:i])
definitions.dfh_pct: trailing-180-record mid-rank percentile of dfh20 within the asset's own history
definitions.f2b2_cell: confirmed cell from T79/financial_signal_regime_v1: funding_pct >= 0.80 AND basis_pct >= 0.66, each a trailing-180 mid-rank pct
definitions.amihud: |ret_1d_i| / quote_volume_i where ret_1d_i = mark[i]/mark[i-1] - 1; amihud_pct = trailing-180 mid-rank pct; tercile split at pct < 1/3 (liquid) / 1/3..2/3 / >= 2/3 (illiquid)

arms.A1a_spearman: Spearman(dfh20, fwd_5d_log_ret) pooled across assets + per-asset table; dfh10 variant; secondary Spearman(dfh20, fwd_1d_log_ret) pooled. Direction prior POSITIVE (near-high -> continue up).
arms.A1b_quintile: top (dfh_pct>=0.80) vs bottom (dfh_pct<=0.20) quintile -> fwd 5d ret, Welch two-sample t, pooled across assets
arms.A1c_conditioned: within the f2b2 cell: Spearman(dfh20, fwd_5d) plus Welch of high-dfh (dfh_pct>=0.50) vs low-dfh (<0.50) - does distance-from-high add inside the confirmed cell
arms.A2_flip: per amihud_pct tercile: Spearman(lag5_ret, fwd_5d_ret). Expect reversal (negative rho) in the high-illiquidity tercile, momentum (positive rho) in the low (liquid) tercile. Flip contrast = Fisher-z difference atanh(rho_low)-atanh(rho_high), expected positive.

statistics.test: Spearman rank correlation (mid-rank ties), t-approx normal two-sided p (same convention as financial_signal_leadlag_v1 / crossvenue); Welch two-sample t with normal-approx two-sided p; min n=10 per side; flip contrast via Fisher atanh difference with normal-approx p (nominal - tercile cells share timestamps)
statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR alpha=0.05 over the fixed 8-cell family above; per-asset tables, mid tercile, secondary 1d Spearman, and per-test-fold sign counts are reported outside the family
caveats: 5d forward labels on daily bars overlap ~5x -> positive autocorrelation; Spearman/Welch p-values are nominal/optimistic
pooled rows across 5 assets share the market factor through common timestamps; pooled cells overstate effective n
amihud tercile membership is per-asset trailing-rank, so terciles are roughly balanced per asset by construction
treat p<0.01 as suggestive, not decisive
